description: Ex-Yugoslav Air Force transport carrying evidencijski broj 71255; built in 1944; flew in to Otočac in 1977 and stayed; rescued from decay in 2015 when Aeroklub „Krila Gacke“ raised it on steel plinths and restored the skin and interior with City of Otočac funding; displayed at the entrance to the aerodrome; the Croatian article calls it a Douglas DC-3 and the OpenStreetMap surveyor tags it DC-3 but a Yugoslav Air Force 712xx serial and a 1944 build make it a military C-47
aliases: DC3; DC-3; C-47; C47; Dakota; C47A

description: One of two F-84 Thunderjets brought to Otočac from the former Bihać (Željava) airfield and intended by the aeroclub to form an aviation museum alongside the DC-3; no serials published; the G was the only Thunderjet mark supplied to Yugoslavia which is why the variant is given
Second of the two ex-Željava Thunderjets at Otočac; no serial published; the Croatian source is undated and their present condition and display state are unverified
